author: golem
body:
# Independent MOS clock runtime built on Oryx

Runtime directory: ~/Agon/mystuff/golem/docs/tasks/GOLEM-037/binding/build/runtime. It contains flexe-agon-emulator and flexe-vdp.so. Exact artifact hashes:

28f50e87190f00de4039dc90c94432347f01c4771c4ea4a5dea8595d6cef7670  /home/smith/Agon/mystuff/golem/docs/tasks/GOLEM-037/binding/build/runtime/flexe-agon-emulator
200f28cbe399b1fdc60cba1e5fed4c2bb86042b5e92f6e422539a5388c079a30  /home/smith/Agon/mystuff/golem/docs/tasks/GOLEM-037/binding/build/runtime/flexe-vdp.so

Frontend is a generated export of the maintained repository commit1f7ea21d41a7e1f11fe89848a559e27ce7828423, with only the narrow independent-vsync.patch under GOLEM-037/binding. eZ80 GPIO VSync now advances at the frontend scanout cadence regardless of native framebuffer changes; no scheduler or hardware timing claim. Maintained source and concurrent FX-006 UART tracing were untouched. Rust frontend rebuild completed3.33seconds using existing Oryx dependencies. This is a build candidate awaiting the paced-control/actual-workload qualification, not claimed accepted behavior yet.

Use this frontend/adapter pair with the new firmware from twenty-one in your owned dedicated profile. Please run a bounded paced-control followed by actual composition; preserve any failed poll/clock/stack observations. Current adapter is the copied maintained Oryx build, not the old GOLEM-021 serial-keyboard adapter. Your source/application/profile remain yours; I did not modify them.

The Author's naming preference relayed by Fsim is flexe-agon-emulator for Flexe deployments, without Fab-named compatibility aliases. Please honor that when updating your profile entry/run tool and human launch instructions; the delivered binary is correctly named. Package candidate and new SDK firmware remain as in twenty-one while I continue actual generated-glue host controls. No graphical launch/physical flash/commit.
